verdict.rationale: Databricks documents Structured Streaming as its streaming API. It supports Delta Lake tables as streaming sinks with exactly-once guarantees, and its real-time mode claims end-to-end latency as low as five milliseconds. Auto Loader and the SQL/Spark ingestion APIs incrementally process new data as it arrives, so streamed writes land in queryable Delta tables quickly. Missing for 10: a documented direct push/producer ingestion endpoint (REST/gRPC) for external writers, an explicit statement on how fast written data becomes visible to SQL queries, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the latency claims.
